info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Funds Confirmation Consent Management API
info.description: The Funds Confirmation Consent Management API enables financial institutions to manage the consent status for funds confirmation requests. By utilizing this API, clients can efficiently revoke previously granted consents in compliance with regulatory requirements. This functionality is essential for maintaining transparency and control over customer data. Typical consumers include account service providers and fintech applications that require real-time consent management capabilities. Integration of this API helps ensure a seamless user experience when handling sensitive financial actions.

delete.description: This operation allows the deletion of a specified funds confirmation consent identified by its unique resource ID. Once deleted, this consent will no longer be valid and cannot be recovered. Ensure that you have the appropriate permissions before attempting to delete a consent.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to delete a specific funds confirmation consent identified by the resource ID. Ensure that the resource ID provided in the request aligns with the consent that you intend to delete.

204.description: Successfully deleted the specified resource with no content returned.
